content:
The audit task was completed successfully with a perfect reward score, producing all required Excel and Word deliverables.
The script successfully merged 'Entries' and 'BreakRules' datasets to apply role-specific thresholds for Break Deficit and Approval Missing flags. Conditional logic correctly identified missing 'Approval Code' values for entries exceeding 'Overtime Threshold' limits. Final outputs 'Timesheet_Compliance_Audit.xlsx' and 'Timesheet_Compliance_Brief.docx' included accurate error summaries and high-priority employee aggregations.
